20	)

22	var (
23		failOn         string
24		baselinePath   string
25		updateBaseline string
26	)
27	
28	var scanCmd = &cobra.Command{
29		Use:   "scan [path]",
30		Short: "Scan a Laravel project for security issues",
31		Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
32		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
33			targetPath := args[0]
34	
35			cfg, err := config.Load()
36			if err != nil {
37				return fmt.Errorf("loading config: %w", err)
38			}
39	
40			// Load baseline if specified
41			var bl *baseline.Baseline
42			if baselinePath != "" {
43				bl, err = baseline.Load(baselinePath)
44				if err != nil {
45					return fmt.Errorf("loading baseline: %w", err)
46				}
47			}
48	
49			// If --output specifies formats (not "tui"), override config and run headless
50			if outputFmt != "tui" {
51				cfg.Output.Formats = parseOutputFormats(outputFmt)
52				return runHeadless(cfg, targetPath, bl)
53			}
54	
55			// If no TTY available, fall back to headless
56			if !term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdin.Fd())) {
57				return runHeadless(cfg, targetPath, bl)
58			}
59	
60			return runWithTUI(cfg, targetPath, bl)
61		},
62	}
63	
64	func configureOrch(orch *orchestrator.Orchestrator, bl *baseline.Baseline) {
65		if bl != nil {
66			orch.SetBaseline(bl)
67		}
68		if updateBaseline != "" {
69			orch.SetBaselinePath(updateBaseline)
70		}
71	}
72	
73	func runWithTUI(cfg *config.WardConfig, targetPath string, bl *baseline.Baseline) error {
74		bus := eventbus.New()
75		model := tui.NewApp(bus, targetPath, Version)
76	
77		p := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen(), tea.WithMouseCellMotion())
78	
79		bridge := eventbus.NewBridge(bus, p)
80		bridge.Start()
81		defer bridge.Stop()
82	
83		// Capture the report for fail-on check
84		var finalReport *models.ScanReport
85		bus.Subscribe(eventbus.EventScanCompleted, func(e eventbus.Event) {
86			data := e.Data.(eventbus.ScanCompletedData)
87			finalReport = data.Report
88		})
89	
90		go func() {
91			orch := orchestrator.New(bus, cfg, targetPath, Version)
92			configureOrch(orch, bl)
93			if err := orch.Run(context.Background()); err != nil {
94				bus.Publish(eventbus.NewEvent(eventbus.EventScanFailed, eventbus.ScanFailedData{
95					Error: err,
96				}))
97			}
98		}()
99	
100		_, err := p.Run()
101		if err != nil {
102			return err
103		}
104	
105		// Check --fail-on threshold after TUI exits
106		return checkFailOn(finalReport)
107	}
108	
109	func runHeadless(cfg *config.WardConfig, targetPath string, bl *baseline.Baseline) error {
110		fmt.Println(banner.Render(Version))
111	
112		bus := eventbus.New()
113	
114		dim := lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.AdaptiveColor{Light: "#757575", Dark: "#9E9E9E"})
115		accent := lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.AdaptiveColor{Light: "#5E35B1", Dark: "#B388FF"}).Bold(true)
116		sevStyles := map[models.Severity]*lipgloss.Style{
117			models.SeverityCritical: ptr(lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("#FF5252")).Bold(true)),
118			models.SeverityHigh:     ptr(lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("#FFB74D")).Bold(true)),
119			models.SeverityMedium:   ptr(lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("#FFD54F"))),
120			models.SeverityLow:      ptr(lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("#81C784"))),
121			models.SeverityInfo:     ptr(lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("#64B5F6"))),
122		}
123	
124		// Capture report for fail-on
125		var finalReport *models.ScanReport
126	
127		// Print events as they happen
128		bus.Subscribe(eventbus.EventStageStarted, func(e eventbus.Event) {
129			data := e.Data.(eventbus.StageStartedData)
130			fmt.Printf("  %s %s\n", accent.Render("●"), data.Stage)
131		})
132	
133		bus.Subscribe(eventbus.EventFindingDiscovered, func(e eventbus.Event) {
134			data := e.Data.(eventbus.FindingDiscoveredData)
135			f := data.Finding
136			style := sevStyles[f.Severity]
137			fmt.Printf("    %s %s\n", style.Render(fmt.Sprintf("[%s]", f.Severity)), f.Title)
138		})
139	
140		bus.Subscribe(eventbus.EventScannerCompleted, func(e eventbus.Event) {
141			data := e.Data.(eventbus.ScannerCompletedData)
142			fmt.Printf("  %s %s — %d findings\n", dim.Render("✓"), data.Name, data.FindingCount)
143		})
144	
145		bus.Subscribe(eventbus.EventLogMessage, func(e eventbus.Event) {
146			data := e.Data.(eventbus.LogMessageData)
147			fmt.Printf("  %s %s\n", dim.Render("["+data.Level+"]"), data.Message)
148		})
149	
150		bus.Subscribe(eventbus.EventScanCompleted, func(e eventbus.Event) {
151			data := e.Data.(eventbus.ScanCompletedData)
152			r := data.Report
153			finalReport = r
154			counts := r.CountBySeverity()
155			fmt.Println()
156			fmt.Printf("  %s %d findings in %s\n", accent.Render("Done."), len(r.Findings), r.Duration.Round(1e6))
157			for _, sev := range []models.Severity{models.SeverityCritical, models.SeverityHigh, models.SeverityMedium, models.SeverityLow, models.SeverityInfo} {
158				if c := counts[sev]; c > 0 {
159					style := sevStyles[sev]
160					fmt.Printf("    %s %d\n", style.Render(fmt.Sprintf("%-10s", sev)), c)
161				}
162			}
163			fmt.Println()
164		})
165	
166		orch := orchestrator.New(bus, cfg, targetPath, Version)
167		configureOrch(orch, bl)
168		if err := orch.Run(context.Background()); err != nil {
169			return err
170		}
171	
172		return checkFailOn(finalReport)
173	}
174	
175	// checkFailOn returns an error (causing exit code 1) if any finding meets or
176	// exceeds the --fail-on severity threshold.
177	func checkFailOn(report *models.ScanReport) error {
178		if failOn == "" || report == nil {
179			return nil
180		}
181	
182		threshold := models.ParseSeverity(failOn)
183	
184		for _, f := range report.Findings {
185			if f.Severity >= threshold {
186				counts := report.CountBySeverity()
187				var parts []string
188				for _, sev := range []models.Severity{models.SeverityCritical, models.SeverityHigh, models.SeverityMedium, models.SeverityLow, models.SeverityInfo} {
189					if sev >= threshold {
190						if c := counts[sev]; c > 0 {
191							parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d %s", c, sev))
192						}
193					}
194				}
195				return fmt.Errorf("findings exceed --fail-on %s threshold: %s", failOn, strings.Join(parts, ", "))
196			}
197		}
198	
199		return nil
200	}
201	
202	func ptr(s lipgloss.Style) *lipgloss.Style { return &s }
203	
204	// parseOutputFormats splits a comma-separated format string into a list.
205	// e.g. "json" → ["json"], "json,sarif" → ["json", "sarif"]
206	func parseOutputFormats(s string) []string {
207		var formats []string
208		for _, f := range strings.Split(s, ",") {
209			f = strings.TrimSpace(f)
210			if f != "" {
211				formats = append(formats, f)
212			}
213		}
214		return formats
215	}
216	
217	func init() {
218		scanCmd.Flags().StringVar(&failOn, "fail-on", "", "exit code 1 if findings at or above this severity (info, low, medium, high, critical)")
219		scanCmd.Flags().StringVar(&baselinePath, "baseline", "", "path to baseline file — suppress known findings")
220		scanCmd.Flags().StringVar(&updateBaseline, "update-baseline", "", "save current findings as a new baseline file at this path")
221		rootCmd.AddCommand(scanCmd)
222	}

# HTTP exposure checks. The pattern type below is not implemented by the
# generic YAML matcher: internal/scanner/web owns a dedicated, stateful
# checker for it (soft-404 probing, response normalization, per-host cache).

rules:
  - id: exposed-git-config
    title: "Exposed .git/config over HTTP"
    description: >
      The web server publicly serves the repository's .git/config file.
      An exposed .git directory can be reconstructed to recover the full
      source code, history, embedded secrets and deployment configuration.
      A hit requires a raw git config body (a [core] section plus a
      repositoryformatversion line); HTML pages, login screens and
      soft-404 responses that merely echo the request path are suppressed.
    severity: high
    category: Exposure
    enabled: true
    tags: [exposure, git, owasp-a05, cwe-538]
    patterns:
      # Dedicated check type handled by internal/scanner/web — the generic
      # rule engine intentionally does not know how to evaluate this.
      - type: http-exposed-git-config
    remediation: |
      Block web access to dotfiles and the .git directory:
        # Apache (.htaccess)
        RedirectMatch 404 /\\.git
        # Nginx
        location ~ /\\.git { deny all; return 404; }
      Verify the rule is part of the deployed server/vhost configuration,
      not just the application, and rotate any secrets that may have leaked.
    references:
      - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/538.html
      - https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/Source_code_disclosure

## 改了什么

**新规则 — `internal/config/defaults/rules/exposure.yaml`**
- 高风险规则 `exposed-git-config`，severity `high`、默认启用，pattern 类型为专用标记 `http-exposed-git-config`（通用 YAML 匹配器不认识也不会执行它，避免改出回归）。
- 现有 `//go:embed defaults/rules/*.yaml` 自动带上新文件，`ward init` 会随其他默认规则一起落到 `~/.ward/rules/`；另外新增 `config.LoadEmbeddedRules()`/`FindRule()`，让没跑过 `ward init` 的机器也能从二进制内嵌规则取到元数据。

**专用判定器 — 新包 `internal/scanner/web/`（`scanner.go` + `scanner_test.go`）**
- 只发 GET；`CheckRedirect: http.ErrUseLastResponse`，3xx 一律不跳转；`io.LimitReader` 把响应体限制在 1 MiB；10s 超时（可配）。
- URL 只按 **origin** 拼 `joinOriginPath(origin, "/.git/config")`，业务 base path 经 `originOf()` 剥掉，不会拼到 app 路径后面。
- 同主机另发 `/.git/ward-<crypto-rand nonce>.probe` 作 soft-404 基线，结果存在 `probeCache` 里，本次 scan 每 host 只探一次。
- 命中条件：必须 200；body 同时多行匹配 `^\s*\[core\]\s*$` 和 `^\s*repositoryformatversion\s*=\s*\d+\s*$`（允许真实 git config 的 tab 缩进）；Content-Type/doctype/密码框判定为 HTML 或登录页直接拒绝；真实响应与探针 `normalize()`（小写、剥 nonce/路径、压空白）后相同则抑制。**探针失败（403/连接错误）不会吞掉严格 raw 命中，但 HTML 回显始终不报。**

**接线**
- `config.go` 加 `web.origins` / `web.timeout`；`init.go` 默认配置模板同步。
- `orchestrator.go` 新增 `buildWebScanner()`：内嵌规则优先、`~/.ward` 同名规则可覆盖，统一过 `rules.disable`/`override`（新增 `config.ApplyRuleOverride`）；目标本身是 http(s) URL 时自动取其 origin，并补一个反 scheme 候选；本地路径且未配 origins 时不启用，零额外请求。
